description: A group of men in dark kimono with topknots and men in Western frock coats and top hats come down a wooden gangway from a black-hulled steamship with a tall funnel and smoke, onto a wet cobbled quay at dusk. Gas lamps and onlookers in flat caps and top hats stand around. A man in a dark kimono and a man in a top hat carry a case. Rigging, ropes and a few distant masts are visible. The image is a full-bleed painting with no frame or text.
